canonical_view_digest_algorithm: SHA256(UTF-8 json.dumps(manifest[view], sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), ensure_ascii=True)); view_sha256 is this digest, with no prefix. It is machine/current-mount/environment specific.
cas_semantics: Require externally pinned baseline canonical digest and current relevant environment equality before filesystem scanning.

Enumerate the same font/config root path sets, capture dir children and alias topology, exact lstat/stat identity (dev,ino,mode,uid,gid,nlink,size,mtime_ns,ctime_ns); atime excluded because own reads may update it.

Reuse baseline content SHA only for unchanged paths in the three font trees: /usr/share/fonts,/usr/local/share/fonts,and stock LO share/fonts. A new/missing font path, mapping change, or any font metadata change refuses before byte reuse.

Rehash other critical configuration/cache/library/ELF-source files with pinned no-symlink ancestor descriptors and leaf O_NOFOLLOW; compare fstat before/after streamed bytes and pathname stat afterward; physically identical file identities hash once.

Reparse fixed safe Fontconfig directory/include/cachedir directives; unknown HOME/XDG paths, unsupported relative paths or remap-dir refuse. Known stock local.conf include resolves against /etc/fonts; complete /etc/fonts set protects absence.
Static LO registry file set and raw registry bytes guard overriding source layers; selected substitution subtrees have content-free digests. Bundled/shared cache layers must remain empty.
Final metadata, symlink topology and complete recursive directory sets revalidated after hashing; then exact canonical view equality with pinned baseline required.

Own HOME/XDG font/config/cache paths listed in manifest.view.empty_user_conditions must be absent at each CAS. A newly generated own Fontconfig cache currently refuses, including after Office load; no silent generated-cache exemption.

No actual selected face, loaded dynamic libraries, Office/user-profile state, measured M, physical/fidelity/historical applicability is inferred. Privileged metadata rollback/hostile kernel is outside metadata reuse trust.
current_instance_facts: Prepared inventory and one current static CAS are evidence of these static bytes/metadata only. Each future Root observer before/load/after callback binds a fresh CAS result to that exact process phase; these preparation facts are not transplanted as runtime lifecycle facts.
external_limits_required: Caller enforces wall<=60s CPU<=30s RSS<=512MiB output<=4MiB; helper internally caps entries+links4096,read1GiB,wall55s. No nested full font rehash. Source caller keeps its original total runtime budgets; these prep maxima do not reset any clock.
mount_for_validator: Add this base/code as one distinct read-only owncode mount to the Root helper; keep the caller own writable scratch separate. code contains both validator and pinned baseline. Root provides matching binding root exactly as reviewed.
namespace_precondition: Run inside the exact reviewed Root build_namespace current observer namespace, with same relevant environment. Root attests current namespace launch/mount provenance independently. Host-path callbacks are unsupported.
no_side_effects: Function starts no process and writes no file; it only reads explicitly trusted namespace software/font/config files, own env and own empty-path metadata. Caller serialization is outside callable.
numeric_identity_comparison: Compare namespace-visible stat UID/GID/dev/ino values inside the same namespace; host numeric ownership differs (vendor host0 is namespace65534 in this run). No host-side stat substitution.
return: On PASS returns manifest-shaped dict whose view_sha256 equals canonical_view_digest and observation.status is metadata_cas_pass_with_critical_rehash. Refusal or OSError means STOP/unknown for this dependency view; never accept a new digest or refresh baseline automatically.
source_loading: Verify validator_source.sha256 externally, then compile/exec pinned bytes in an isolated module dict with __name__ not __main__. Do not import UNO or run main. Pin and parse <=4MiB manifest bytes separately; pass parsed dict plus externally retained canonical_view_digest.
